product.olivetti-snx-160-rm.summary: The rackmount Systema 160 with the Olimpus board.
product.olivetti-snx-160-rm.history: Olivetti documented the SNX 160/RM as the 19-inch rack variant of the Olimpus platform.
product.olivetti-snx-160-rm.architecture: The rack supported removable drives. The BA2298 could take two Pentiums and hot-swapping required a DPT RAID controller.
product.olivetti-snx-160-rm.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-snx-160-rm.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-snx-160-rm.service-guid: Olivetti, SNX / NetStrada – Pocket Service Guide, ch. 6
